entries.name: Charles McCray

expected.charges: Unlawful possession of weapons (N.J.S. 2A:151-41) — arrested in the July 1967 Newark rebellion and tried with LeRoi Jones (Amiri Baraka)
expected.convicted: Convicted November 6, 1967; weapons conviction reversed December 23, 1968 and new trial ordered.
expected.sentence: Verdict as recorded: Yes — convicted November 6, 1967 with LeRoi Jones; conviction reversed on appeal December 23, 1968 (State v. Jones), new trial ordered

updates.sentence: Sentenced January 4, 1968 to an eighteen-month term: twelve months in custody and six months on probation, plus a $500 fine. The weapons conviction was reversed December 23, 1968 and a new trial ordered. Contemporary reporting confirms initial jail admission July 14, 1967. The actual bail-release date and any later custody intervals remain unverified; the sentence is not recorded as time served.

entries.rationale: Add documented initial jail admission and sentencing date. July 24, 1967 contemporary defense statement says all three were jailed after July 14 arrest. January 5, 1968 AP report specifies sentences imposed Thursday January 4. Preserve unknown release; sentence and probation are not actual imprisonment totals.
